_about: Page changes switched on for a share of films at a time (scripts/lib/rollout.js). Stages: 10, 25, 50, 100 — 'percent' is the share now; a 'schedule' moves it up on the dates given. Set percent and schedule to 0 to turn a change off.

honest-not-announced.what: 'hasn't been announced' -> 'No OTT release date in our sources yet'; titles 'Awaiting Date' (lib/honest.js)

intent-titles.what: overseas cinema run: 'Release Date in <country>: <date> · Streaming <window>'; out a year+: no 'OTT Release Date' in the title (lib/filmpage.js filmTitleTag)

one-score.what: one rating, count and FilmyChill Score per film across editions: the freshest TMDB count any edition holds (lib/migrate.js shareScore)

lean-page.what: every fact once: rating only in the score ring, count once, platform in the answer box first, runtime/genre/language in the header, one skip list, Story after the cast (lib/filmpage.js LEAN_PAGE)

google-hide.what: catalogue pages Google never showed (google-hidden.json, 90 days to 23 Oct): googlebot noindex, out of the sitemaps and hreflang; Bing and visitors keep them (lib/googlehide.js). 0% = dry run (build logs the count); 10% at the 26 Oct evening build, 100% at the 27 Oct morning build
